steps.title: Concession and contrast: agree with a point without giving up your position
steps.body: A strong argument can recognize a valid point and then show its limit. Use certes… mais… or bien que… for a concession, tandis que / alors que to contrast two situations, and en revanche to introduce a different side. Put the concession where it belongs: do not use a contrast word if the ideas do not actually contrast. At this stage, learn the subjunctive after bien que as a fixed pattern; Unit 5 explains the choice more fully.

steps.title: Concession and contrast: agree with a point without giving up your position
rows: Bien que le télétravail réduise certains trajets, il ne convient pas à tous les postes.
Although remote work reduces some commutes, it does not suit every role.
Certes, les réunions en ligne sont pratiques, mais elles ne remplacent pas chaque échange.
Certainly, online meetings are convenient, but they do not replace every interaction.
Le premier horaire offre de la souplesse; en revanche, le second facilite la coordination.
The first schedule offers flexibility; by contrast, the second makes coordination easier.

steps.prompt: What does en revanche signal here?
steps.explain: En revanche introduces a contrasting point.

steps.prompt: Which is the best response to an overgeneralized claim?
